senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; תּקַף)strength, power. Mekh. B’shall., s. 6 (ref. to Ex. XIV, 25) אין איתנו אלא תָקְפוֹ ethans means its strength.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 19a:12">Meg. 19ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Esther 9:29">Esth. IX, 29</cite>) <he>תָּקְפוֹ של אחשורוש</he> ‘the whole strength’ refers to the power of Ahasverus (as described in the first chapters of Esther); <he>תּוֹקְפוֹ של מרדכי</he> to the power of Mordecai (beginning with II, 5); <he>תוקפו של המן</he> to Haman’s power (beginning with III, 1); <he>תקפו של נס</he> the strength of the wonderful salvation (beginning with VI, 1).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16:1">Gen. R. s. 16</cite>, beg. (ref. to <cite ref="Job 14:20">Job XIV, 20</cite>) <he>ת׳ שנתן הקב״ה וכ׳</he> the power which God gave Adam was to be for ever.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 100:7">Gen. R. s. 100</cite> <he>כל תקפו של אבל וכ׳</he> the height of mourning is on the third day (after burial); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:5:7">Y. M. Kat. III, 82ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>אין תוקפו … עד שלשה ימים</he> the height of mourning lasts only three days; a. e.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 19b:21">Snh. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>תוקפו של יוסף ענוותנותו וכ׳</he> that which was with Joseph an achievement of strength (self-control) was with Boaz a humble (plain) act.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 323:4">Sifré Deut. 323</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 32:31">Deut. XXXII, 31</cite>) <he>לא כת׳ שאתה וכ׳</he> the power which thou givest us is not like the power which thou givest them (the gentiles); <he>כשאתה ניתן להם את הת׳ וכ׳</he> when thou givest them the power, they deal with us with cruelty &c.; a. e.
